input.quote: (iv) Transition. Each Party shall use Diligent Efforts to cooperate with the other and/or its designee to effect a smooth and orderly transition in the Development, sale and ongoing marketing, promotion and commercialization of the Product in the Ono Territory during the Wind-down Period and to conduct in an expeditious manner any activities to be conducted under this Section 14.2.
input.rationale: Article XIV's wind-down regime runs one way: Ono must transition studies (p0646-p0647), assign Regulatory Filings and hand over all Data and Ono Know-How (p0656, p0659), provide customer data (p0660), grant licences (p0661) and return or destroy Array Materials and Confidential Information (p0662). Nothing anywhere (including Article X, which has no return-of-Confidential-Information mechanic) obliges Array to give Ono transition assistance or to return or export Ono's data. The generic mutual cooperation sentence in 14.2(a)(iv) is limited to transitioning the Product back to Array during the redacted Wind-down Period and fixes no assistance duration and no data export deadline, so no fallback element is met; Section 14.2 is also expressed to apply only "In case of termination", not on expiration. We therefore insert one short reciprocal clause at the fallback level (90 days' assistance; export of Ono data within 30 days of expiry or termination), omitting the preferred six-month, then-current-rates, machine-readable and certified-deletion terms.

ops.text: Transition Assistance and Return of Ono Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Array shall (A) at Ono's request, provide transition assistance to Ono for a period of at least ninety (90) days following such expiration or termination, and (B) within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination, export and deliver to Ono all Data and other information belonging to, supplied by or processed for Ono that is in Array's possession.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XIV runs entirely in Array's favour, so we added a short reciprocal exit provision: at least 90 days of transition assistance from Array and export of our data within 30 days of expiry or termination. This is our fallback position.
proposal.summary: Insert Array-side transition assistance and return of Ono data on expiry or termination

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
